title: Estar + Participle: The Result
goal: Use estar + participle to describe the result of an action, and tell it apart from the passive with ser.

items: I can use *estar* + participle to describe the result of an action.
I can tell the action (*fue cerrada*) from the result (*está cerrada*).
I can make the participle agree with the subject after *estar*.
